items.prompt: With quantum 2 and queue [A:3,B:1], what happens immediately after the first service of A?

options.why: One unit of A remains, so it is unfinished.

options.text: A stays at the front and immediately takes another turn.
options.why: That would bypass B and violate round-robin queue order.

options.text: B is dropped to make room for A.
options.why: No eviction policy is part of the task.

options.text: Elapsed becomes 2 and the queue becomes [B:1,A:1].
options.why: An unfinished job rejoins the back after consuming one quantum.

items.explanation: An unfinished job rejoins the back after consuming one quantum.
